issues.description: The problem specification explicitly requires the Farm to use a List implemented with an ArrayList (and to initialize an ArrayList in the no-argument constructor). However, the reference solution implements the farm storage as a Queue backed by a LinkedList (private Queue<Animal> animals). This contradicts the stated attribute type/implementation in the exercise instructions and may confuse students about the required collection type and the expected getter/setter signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation consistent with the problem statement: change the Farm's field and accessor types to use List<Animal> (and initialize it as new ArrayList<>()) in the no-argument constructor, and update addAnimal/feedAllAnimals/singFarmSong to operate on the List. Alternatively, update the problem statement to allow using Queue/LinkedList and relax the requirement for ArrayList if that was the intended design.
